blends.name: Forge 100 Million Upliftium Crystal
blends.desc:
You can use crystallized Upliftium to forge more massive crystals. The forces needed to forge such imposing crystals are so extensive, that you will need fragments of the Uplift World itself to power it.

The resulting crystal will be so huge that it will become a lens itself that channels and focusses Upliftium energy. This means having one of these crystals will mine and emit Upliftium itself, based on the scale of your crystals.

Don’t have any 1 Mio Upliftium crystals? Try it here:
https://neftyblocks.com/c/upliftium.hi/marketplace?sort=created&order=desc&collection_name=upliftium.hi&match=1%20Mio%20Crystallized%20Upliftium

Don’t have any Land Shards? Try it here:
https://neftyblocks.com/c/upliftworld/marketplace?sort=created&order=desc&collection_name=upliftworld&match=Uplift%20World%20Shard

Don’t have any Land Shards Packs? Try it here:
https://neftyblocks.com/c/upliftworld/marketplace?sort=created&order=desc&collection_name=upliftworld&match=Land%20Shard%20Pack

or forge them from Land Shards:
https://neftyblocks.com/c/upliftworld/blends?category=Recycle%20a%20Land%20Key
